plan.purpose: Derive physically structured conditional history and compare fixed polynomial/rational coordinates and lossless orthogonal pairing without changing rolling solver.
plan.scope: Stationary representation-only fabricated comparison; not a causal learning, aging, coverage or full SRAM qualification.

inputs.rule: Reuse frozen64 raw ADC records;4096-record diagnostic repeats those input/voltage codes chronologically with carried physical state. No state reset at repetition; no plant truth or fitting.

queries.local: Original33public mean/axis nodes plus64 joint points in public support intersect mean+/-0.4publicSD.
queries.global: 32 additional points uniform in original public rectangular support.
queries.basis_nodes: Degree+1 Chebyshev roots in each selected coordinate; nodes depend only on frozen domain and family, not observations or query outcomes.

arms.local_domain: Original nonlinear-coordinate support intersect public mean+/-0.5publicSD; reciprocal capacity endpoints obtained from logQ endpoints. Never extrapolate outside declared domain.

algebra.history: Stream normalized residual coefficient rows into a square-root QR factor. Never drop constant residual energy or prior/likelihood distinctions.
algebra.response: Propagate free/forced response at fixed rate nodes using exact original recurrences; project rows in a fixed basis. Nonlinear input-driven responses are not evolved by the latest fitted rate.
algebra.rational_mapping: For each positive rate/timeconstant p, u=(p-pc)/(p+pc)/rho, pc=sqrt(pmin*pmax),rho=(sqrt(pmax/pmin)-1)/(sqrt(pmax/pmin)+1). Equivalent tanh((logp-center)/2)/tanh(halfwidth/2). Chebyshev polynomials in u give fixed negative-real rational poles. OCV coordinates remain affine z0/chi.
algebra.pairing: Forced/free response retained separately with cross-products. Orthogonal control rotates all feature pairs by45degrees and transforms query features inversely; retains all components. Not two independent observations.
algebra.composition_limits: Appending the same already-global rows is associative in exact arithmetic; generic independently entered blocks need parameter-dependent transport of bases. No claim of finite-degree closure under arbitrary transport or uncertain aging.

measurement: centered likelihood error oscillation against exactC replay
feature and factor storage lower bounds; actual hostmemory notfirmware
construction/query walltime only as diagnostic, no optimizedCcandidate speedclaim
row/batch QR and direct residual consistency

qualification.derivative_controls: Analytic feature derivatives versus finite differences atpublicmean, frozenepsilon1e-5publicSD; separate scaled atol/rtol1e-5 regression allowances.
qualification.recurrence_control: Independent response predictor against originalC replay at all queries; expected cost/endpoint agreement rtol2e-10 atol2e-8 (finite regression only).
qualification.QR: Independent NumPyQR/direct residual norm versus streamingC factor rtol2e-10 atol2e-8; no tolerance adaptation.
qualification.gate_scope: Existing finite contrast criterion applied descriptively to this new frozen stencil; not replacement for preserved545-node canonical gate.

interpretation: No point estimator output treated as evidence.
Orthogonal change of coordinates alone cannot reduce algebraic dimension or improve exact representation error.
Fixed-domain local pass cannot be called global history fidelity; domains must cover actual future queries or declare unavailable.
A record repeated in a fabricated fixture is a declared new observation; this is not replaying a posterior as independent evidence.
No source/solver/prior/likelihood or physicalmodel changes; candidate interpolation may violate originalphysicalinvariants and must be judged against reference, not automatically called passive.
Full degree3/4 factors exceeding10240B are diagnostic comparison arms, never deployment proposals.

external_context.supports: Pole/residue rational response representations; this experiment uses a fixed Cayley basis, not vector fitting.
Orthogonal coordinates preserve signal representation when all components are retained; not a history sufficiency theorem.
